news.title: AI数据中心企业融资困难
news.snippet: [受市场环境影响，AI数据中心企业普遍融资困难，多家公司难以获得资金，扩张计划受阻。]
news.raw_snippet:
Other data center firms are also struggling to secure funds. Australian company Permian withdrew its initial public offering (IPO) plan on October 9, which aimed to raise about 5 billion dollars, due to difficulties in attracting investment. The IPO, set to be Australia’s second-largest ever, was abandoned as investors raised concerns over debt burdens and high valuations. Permian decided to raise funds through private markets instead. Nscale, a British AI data center company, reportedly [...] data centers are now facing difficulties in securing funding. Concerns over an "AI bubble" — whether massive investments and high corporate valuations can be sustained by actual profits — are growing, leading to a pullback in lending or investing in data center firms. [...] “As investors begin scrutinizing not just growth potential but actual profitability and debt repayment capabilities, securing funding for AI data center firms is expected to become more challenging,” said a tech industry source.

news.title: 各国如何评估AI模型？
news.snippet: [布鲁金斯学会指出，AI模型评估旨在衡量能力、风险与安全性，各国正探索多样化监管路径。]
news.raw_snippet: Artificial intelligence (AI) evaluations aim to measure AI models or systems under specified conditions for a particular capability or risk, or for systemic capabilities, risks, performance, or societal impact. Directed evaluations typically select a target and measure an observable proxy for it, aiming to minimize the construct validity gap, or the distance between the target and the proxy. Exploratory evaluations can also be used to anticipate future AI system properties, impacts, risks, use [...] The dialogue convened days after the publication of a widely read essay from a frontier AI lab leader calling for independent third-party evaluators embedded in frontier AI companies, and the postponement of OpenAI’s initial public offering attributed to safety concerns. Participants agreed that independent, third-party evaluation is now necessary but offered different perspectives on what to measure, where in the AI stack to measure it, who should be trusted to do it, and what should follow [...] are carried out by various contracted parties. Paid evaluation consultancies and potential purchasers of an AI system are other examples.
